_comment: A hand transcription of DAEMON-SPEC §9's endpoint table, cross-checked on 2026-08-23
against crates/daemon/src/api.rs's routes() and every #[utoipa::path] under
crates/daemon/src/api/*.rs at commit e09d968 plus eieio-8yq.17's DELETE
/services/{service}. It excludes GET /openapi.json itself, which is the
schema-serving route rather than an operation eio-cli issues.
THIS IS NOT /openapi.json. crates/daemon has no lib target (eieio-yck.1's finding:
see that issue's report for what would close this gap), so nothing in crates/cli can
ask the daemon what it actually serves, and this crate's tests must not spawn a real
daemon to find out (eieio-yck.1's verification rule). tests/api_surface.rs therefore
checks only that eio-cli's client.rs and this file agree with each other -- it cannot
detect the daemon's router drifting out from under both of them.
Regenerate this file by re-reading crates/daemon/src/api.rs's routes() (or, once it
exists, a live /openapi.json) whenever DAEMON-SPEC §9 changes, and update
crates/cli/src/client.rs's ENDPOINTS and its Client methods in the same commit.
